Final round on PR #638 (branch wp-interactive-cli-compare; check it out in a worktree, push to the same branch). Trail #487. Four findings, fix each minimally: (1) 01M84ZJS85VP53854G9A54MW77: changed-package preselection must never block add: if change detection errors, print one warning to stderr and show the full list with nothing preselected (add.rs about 60). Test with a forced detection failure. (2) 01M84ZJS8AQBPEZ5EQACT6V2DT: a SIGINT received while the editor is open must not accept the draft: record it in the existing terminal-owner state and, when the editor returns, run the existing cancel() instead of accepting. No signal forwarding. (3) 01M84ZJS8F3HPKBHM8360YCA2G: in add.rs check prompt eligibility (json mode without --package -> E214 with the --package hint) before validating --summary. (4) 01M84ZJS8M50Y8W4TPR11DA9F5: the pty test Session's Drop kills and reaps the child. Resolve each with entire trail finding resolve <id> --trail 487 --branch wp-interactive-cli-compare -m '<one line>'. After pushing, if the next review raises more low findings, report them to the lead instead of fixing. cargo test -p callisto-cli, just lint, merge origin/main, push. Rules (from the lead session close-gap-for-alpha). Be fast and lean; GitHub CI runs the full suite, so don't duplicate it.
- Read AGENTS.md. Prefer a type or private constructor over a check; delete checks a type makes redundant; fix sibling call sites in the same PR.
- A check, preview, dry run or test must run on exactly the structure the real path executes (one shared graph or derivation, the real tool), never a projection, copy or re-implementation. When fixing a failing or flaky test, assert the measured behaviour still happens.
- No new traits, async or frameworks. No new error codes, JSON keys or flags without asking the lead.
- Work in a named worktree off fresh origin/main. Write the failing test first for behaviour changes.
- Local checks: `cargo test -p <touched crate>` and `just lint` (clippy) for the crates you touched; `just doc-check` if docs changed. Do not run local `just ci` or a fresh reviewer unless the lead asks; let GitHub CI do the full run.
- If you change a public signature in callisto-manifests or callisto-model, also run `just fuzz-check` (the fuzz crate is outside the workspace, so crate tests miss it).
- Run `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff` only for new decision logic, not for merges, renames, docs, CI or tests; never commit mutants.out*.
- Merges and conflict resolutions: resolve, run the touched crate's tests, push. Nothing else.
- Changeset (`cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add ...`) only for user-visible changes, written for users.
- Signed commits, no session trailer. Merge the latest origin/main right before pushing (no rebase, no force-push). Push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>, confirm with git ls-remote, link the given trail, open with entire trail ci-pr.
- Trails are semantic outcomes shared by many PRs. Never change a trail's title or description (no `entire trail update` on it, no `entire trail create` to rename it). Put PR-specific text in the PR body with `gh pr edit <n> --body-file`. Link your branch to the trail the lead named; if your work does not fit that trail's outcome, ask the lead instead of linking it anyway.
- If CI fails, fix that failure only. If Entire raises findings, fix only wrong results, broken recovery, security issues or checks that cannot fail; report the rest to the lead.
- Report to the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) in under 5 lines: PR, sha, what you ran.
- CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is cores/5; never run two cargo builds in one worktree.

content.text:
I stopped as asked. Nothing is committed or pushed, and none of the four findings is resolved on trail 487.

The edits are uncommitted in worktree `wp-interactive-cli-compare-final`, on branch `worktree-wp-interactive-cli-compare-final`, based on `8f5792abf`. They are:
- **Preselection:** a failed change detection now prints one warning and shows the full list with nothing preselected (`add.rs`).
- **Check order:** prompt eligibility is now checked before `--summary` is validated, through a new `require_prompt` in `tty.rs`.
- **Editor SIGINT:** a SIGINT while the editor is open is recorded in the existing terminal-owner state, and `cancel()` runs when the editor returns.
- **pty tests:** the test `Session` now kills and reaps its child on drop, and two new pty tests cover the editor SIGINT and the failed detection.

None of it has been tested. The pty tests failed in the sandbox because it blocks opening a pty, and my unsandboxed rerun was not approved, so `cargo test -p callisto-cli` and `just lint` were never run. I also did not merge `origin/main`.

I sent the lead (`close-gap-for-alpha`) the same report. I left the two design-independent fixes uncommitted because they are untested. Say if you want them committed and pushed anyway.
